penalties.details: For over-weighment in the purchase and weighment of sugarcane under Rules 120 and 122 of the U.P. Sugarcane (Regulation of Supply and Purchase) Rules, 1954. Order No. 933-34 Dated 12-12-2025 levying penalty of Rs. 10000/-.
penalties.impact: Fine of Rs. 10,000 was deposited on 06-02-2026 against the said order.

penalties.details: The Assistant Sugar Commissioner, Sitapur, conducted a surprise inspection and, upon immediate on-site verification, found that farmers were being charged for unloading sugarcane from their trolleys, in contrary to Rule 122 of the Sugarcane (Supply and Purchase) Rules, 1954. Order No. 986-87 dated 22-12-2025 levying penalty of Rs. 20000/-.
penalties.impact: Fine of Rs. 20,000 was deposited on 30-01-2026 against the said order.
